newsitem.title: USA: Aquarion Co seeks to merge subsidiaries.
newsitem.headline: Aquarion Co seeks to merge subsidiaries.

text.p: Aquarion Co said on Friday that its Bridgeport Hydraulic Co subsidiary filed an application with the Connecticut Department of Public Utility Control (DPUC) to merge with some of its subsidiaries.
Under the proposal, Stamford Water Co, New Canaan Water Co and Ridgefield Water Supply Co subsidiaries would be merged into Bridgeport Hydraulic, Aquarion said.
The company said it was seeking approval by November 15, 1996. If the regulatory agency allows the merger, it would become effective January 1, 1997, Aquarion said.
Aquarion said the merger would enable it to better control expenses and cut financing costs.
